definition: Highest ligand-to-labelled-protein molar equivalent measured for the pair.
entry_rule: Enter the actual maximum for each pair; maxima may differ between pairs.

definition: Manually determined fraction of labelled protein bound at the highest ligand equivalent.
entry_rule: Enter only when supported by the experimental analysis; the build does not infer it from equivalents.

definition: The same bound fraction expressed as a percentage.
entry_rule: When both forms are supplied, this must equal 100 × fraction_bound_highest_ligand.
